name: cli_spawn_agent
description: Spawn an isolated Antigravity CLI subagent on a specified Google account and workspace/worktree with custom model tier.

task_prompt.description: Detailed task description / instruction for the subagent.

model.description: Model ID to run (gemini-3.8-flash-high, claude-sonnet-4-6, pro).

workspace.description: Optional workspace path or dedicated worktree directory.

title.description: Optional human-readable title for the agent session.
